WFR-DRY-1.description: Scratch checkpoint 1 exists and produces docs/ai-workflow/dry-run/scratch/a.txt, proving a trivial single-file checkpoint commits and is discoverable by its Workflow-Checkpoint trailer.

WFR-DRY-2.description: Scratch checkpoint 2 exists and produces docs/ai-workflow/dry-run/scratch/b.txt; this is the checkpoint deliberately left IN_PROGRESS/dirty at the end of S6's second session, so S13 (same-worktree resume) has real uncommitted work to resume. S13 completes it; it is COMPLETE from that point on and is never reopened for a later scenario.

WFR-DRY-3.description: Scratch checkpoint 3 exists and produces docs/ai-workflow/dry-run/scratch/c.txt. After S13 completes checkpoint 2, checkpoint 3 is started in worktree A and deliberately left IN_PROGRESS with no completion commit: it is the subject of S14 (mismatched-worktree refusal, which must make zero state mutation and therefore leaves it IN_PROGRESS) and then, unchanged, of S15 (interrupted-checkpoint recovery in a fresh session). S15's recovery decision completes it, so every scratch checkpoint is COMPLETE before S7's implementation review.
